name: @ecommerce/api-client
description: The BFF client, generated from its OpenAPI document by Orval (ADR-0004). Never hand-written.

scripts.//verify-generated: ADR-0004: CI must fail when the committed client has drifted from the BFF's document. Uses `git status --porcelain`, not `git diff`, on purpose — diff only sees tracked files, so an output that was never committed at all would pass a diff-based gate while asserting nothing. Untracked output is itself the failure: it means a frontend build cannot work without a live BFF.
scripts.verify-generated: orval --config orval.config.ts && node -e "const s=require('child_process').execSync('git status --porcelain -- src/generated',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(); if(s){console.error('Generated client is not committed, or has drifted from the BFF document:\n'+s); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.//build: This package is consumed as TypeScript source, so its 'build' is a typecheck — there is no artifact for apps/web to wait on, only a guarantee that what it imports compiles.
